name: docx
tagline_zh: Word 文档里的文字像被锁住？一键提取，连表格、批注、页眉页脚都逃不掉。比复制粘贴快 10 倍，还保留原始格式。
tagline_en: Stuck with text locked in Word? Extract everything—tables, comments, headers—in one click. 10x faster than.
desc_en: Extract text from Microsoft Word documents
why_zh: 别家只抽正文，它连批注和页眉都捞出来，且保留结构，适合做文档分析或迁移。
why_en: Unlike others, it also pulls comments and headers, preserving structure—ideal for document analysis or migration.
